known.title: label removal ids come from the pre-write gh issue view, which reads only labels(first:100); a phase label past the first 100 gets no removal id, so status writes and then fails, and archive/retire of an owned plan return early without the label check; the fake gh returns every label for issue view, so the paged-label test passes
connectionNodes stops only when nodes.length > limit and listPlans no longer slices, so with more than 500 plans list fetches a sixth page and prints up to 600 plans past the 500-plan cap
the contract's command table says list prints each group newest first, but listPlans sorts each group by ascending issue number (and a test asserts ascending order)

the only test of the pre-write race refusal 'plan issue changed remotely; re-read and retry' was dropped in the split (base scripts/tests/plan-cli.mjs:331-340), leaving that refusal untested and the fake gh remoteChange support unused
the code-review diff example passes $file unquoted to git diff --no-index, so an untracked path with spaces or glob characters splits or expands and drops out of the review diff
preWriteIssue reports a malformed gh issue view response as 'gh api graphql returned malformed plan issue', the snapshot query's message, so the error names the wrong command
